title: Release and publish path must refuse when CHANGELOG.md at the tagged commit has no heading for the version
description: v0.14.1 was tagged at 053d8595 and staged to the release-candidate dist-tag while that commit CHANGELOG.md had only Unreleased and 0.14.0 headings, no 0.14.1 heading (QCLI-499; opum-doc relay 893 ruled a fix-forward on dev, the tag is not moved). The GitHub Release cut in promote-release.mjs reads the section at the commit the tag peels to and refuses only at promote time, after qualification and staging have already consumed the tag. The refusal must come earlier, on the tag and publish path itself, so a tag that cannot produce its release notes is caught before staging. Sensitive: release tooling.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The publish and staging path (publish-release.mjs) refuses, before any credential is read or npm call is made, when CHANGELOG.md at the commit the release tag peels to has no heading for the version being published, and the refusal names the missing heading.
The same path accepts and proceeds when that heading is present, proved by a test that runs both cases.
A test mutates the check, not its input, and shows the refusal case goes red when the check is removed.
